  1. Description

Annotation Interface BOMLineItem

@Retention(SOURCE) @Target(FIELD) public @interface BOMLineItem
Indicates the annotated field declares a block that is to appear as a line item in a bill-of-materials (BOM). The line item will be entitled by the type name of the field variable. The multiplicity of the variable will be used to specify the quantity of the line item in the BOM. The block class will be used to identify the other information that will be used for the line item, e.g. values for the line item, e.g. size, weigth, etc. and comments containing defintion of other columns of information for the line item, e.g.description, sourcing, version, etc. An example declaration is as follows. 


&#64;BOMLineItem
&#64;Part
VoltageSource voltageSource;

	:

&#64;Override
protected void createParts()
{
	voltageSource = new VoltageSource("VoltageSource");
}
